justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear low-relief figural carving in profile on an upright stone face, with A showing a long horizontal file of costumed human figures in procession, one behind another with staffs and hands touching, and B showing a single isolated quadruped-like creature plus abstract angular signs within a recessed panel. The depicted content differs fundamentally: a repeated, naturalistically detailed human procession frieze versus a solitary schematic animal and non-figural symbols, with no shared motif, grouping or arrangement beyond the generic fact of relief carving.
